positions.name: QuixoticZeppelinExpungementDirectives
positions.frame: What directives govern the removal and expungement of institutional records concerning the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, helium procurement, and flight routes?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere as direct operational mandates instructing the complete erasure of institutional knowledge and documentation regarding the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, helium contracts, and routes.
